summary: The isolated frozen install exposes independent TypeScript 6 compatibility and TypeScript 7 native compiler roots with the required exact versions.
verified: node_modules is a local directory in the isolated migration worktree, not a symlink to the active main worktree.
require resolution identifies distinct local package paths for typescript and typescript7.
pnpm list reports the root alias pair and TypeScript 6 across all 36 projects.
The Phase 2 resolution contract uses the same TS6 compatibility and TS7 native ownership model.
separate_preexisting_observation: packages/activity-tutorial declares tutorial-check -> ./dist/cli.js, but the dist CLI is absent. This is unrelated to the compiler aliases and did not make the frozen strict-peer install fail.
